Directed review round: units drawn with probability proportional to size

Source: R/select_directed.R
select_directed.Rd

Draws a review round aimed at the units where a review is worth most, while keeping a known inclusion probability for every clip. A unit is a group of occasions, such as site x month x species. Each unit gets a size, typically the expected gain of one review predicted by an occupancy model; n_units units are drawn with probability proportional to size (PPS), one occasion is drawn at random within each drawn unit, and every prediction of that occasion at or above threshold becomes a clip, as in sampling_mode = "random_detections" of select_clips().

Usage

select_directed(
  detections,
  units,
  n_units,
  threshold,
  size_col = "size",
  floor = 0.05,
  occasion_unit = c("file", "minute"),
  previous = NULL,
  seed = 2026,
  remap_from = NULL,
  remap_to = NULL
)

Arguments

detections

Predictions, as returned by read_selection_tables().

units

Data frame with one row per eligible unit: the columns that define the unit (any columns of the prepared predictions, such as site, species_code and month) and the size column. Only listed units are drawn, so leave out the units that need no review, for instance those where a review has already confirmed the species.

n_units

Number of units to draw.

threshold

Confidence threshold: an occasion is a candidate when it has at least one prediction at or above it, and its clips are all such predictions. Use the threshold of the occupancy analysis.

size_col

Column of units with the size (non-negative).

floor

Share of the mean size added to every size, so that a unit with size 0 can still be drawn. Without it, a unit the model judges worthless is never reviewed and the model is never corrected there.

occasion_unit

The occasion of the occupancy model: "file" (the whole recording) or "minute" (minute of the file, from file_offset).

previous

Manifests of earlier review rounds (of any design), as paths or data frames. Their clips are left out, matched by recording file and start: an occasion is a candidate only while it has a prediction at or above threshold not yet reviewed.

seed

Seed of the draws. The global random number generator is left as it was.

remap_from, remap_to

Replace the prefix remap_from of the begin_path paths by remap_to, e.g. "N:/" and "/Volumes/Arara/". Backslashes are turned into forward slashes first.

Value

The manifest of the round, with the columns of select_clips(), sampling_mode = "directed_pps", n_candidates (\(N_u\)), n_drawn = 1 and, at the end, stratum (the unit, its values joined by |). The attribute "units" holds the units with their size, size_used (after the floor), n_occasions, inclusion_prob_unit and drawn, for the record of the round; save it next to the manifest.

Details

Inclusion probabilities. With sizes \(x_u\) (after the floor), the inclusion probability of unit \(u\) is \(\pi_u = n x_u / \sum x\), and units whose \(\pi_u\) would exceed 1 are taken with certainty while the others share the rest of n_units. The units are drawn by systematic PPS sampling in a random order, which gives exactly these \(\pi_u\). The occasion is then drawn among the \(N_u\) candidate occasions of the unit, so each clip has inclusion_prob \(= \pi_u / N_u\). The round is conditional on the earlier rounds: inclusion_prob is the probability of this round, given what was reviewed before.

What the weights support. Weighted by 1 / inclusion_prob, the clips of the round estimate totals and ratios (such as the precision) of the candidate predictions of the listed units (Horvitz and Thompson 1952, doi:10.1080/01621459.1952.10483446 ). Systematic PPS has no simple joint inclusion probability, so the exact design variance is not available; approximations that treat the draw as with replacement are usually conservative. The units were chosen by a model, so the round is not a sample of all predictions: an occupancy model that reads it needs the inclusion probabilities, which export_occupancy_data() writes.

A unit without candidate occasions (all reviewed, or no prediction at or above threshold) is dropped with a message before the draw.

See also

select_clips(), cut_clips(), export_occupancy_data().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
pred <- read_selection_tables("N:/Arara")
units <- readr::read_csv("expected_gain.csv") # site, month, species_code, size
sel <- select_directed(pred, units, n_units = 40, threshold = 0.5,
                       previous = "validation_r1/clip_manifest.csv")
man <- cut_clips(sel, "validation_directed")
readr::write_csv(man, "validation_directed/clip_manifest.csv")
readr::write_csv(attr(sel, "units"), "validation_directed/units.csv")
} # }
